content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipeda district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property in a divorce case the defendant was awarded a vw golf car an apartment and a garage as their personal property the applicant has been ordered to pay the defendant compensation of eur 14149 the court also determined that the parties credit agreement remains unchanged and both parties are responsible for fulfilling their contractual obligations various articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property were discussed the applicant requested the court to dissolve the marriage seek child maintenance determine contact arrangements for the minor child division of matrimonial property compensation and for the defendant to fulfill their obligations under a credit agreement the defendant filed a counterclaim requesting the dissolution of the marriage certain assets and compensation the court concluded that the disputed apartment belongs to the defendant as personal property but the applicant is entitled to compensation for their contribution to its purchase the court ordered the applicant to pay the defendant compensation and for both parties to bear their own costs the court supported the counterclaim and dissolved the marriage the defendant was granted a favorable outcome the court also declared that the credit agreement between the parties remains joint and several both parties are responsible for fulfilling their contractual obligations the defendant was ordered to pay the costs of serving procedural documents to the state budget similarly the applicant was also required to pay the same amount for the costs of serving procedural documents to the state budget
